title: Fire: route a crew outside the keep-out zone
problem_line: A grass fire spreads towards the house. Which door can the crew reach, and by which way?

beats.caption: A grass fire spreads from the south-west (screening model, time compressed).
Keep-out: ground the fire reaches within two minutes of the crew getting there.
The crew route is planned live and re-planned as the fire grows; smoke costs extra.
The route reaches a door outside the keep-out area. Nothing here says an entry is safe.

success_line: A walking route with no keep-out cells, to a door the fire does not reach in time.
